name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: Right-click actions on a file, row, or canvas.

motionProfile.reason: Context Menu opens and closes its existing popup surface; content and native focus retain their current owners.

popup.anchored/css-transition.reason: Context Menu integrates popup opening at its own parts, using the reached installed executor.

exit.fade/css-transition.reason: Context Menu integrates popup closing at its own parts, using the reached installed executor.

state.morph/one-shot.reason: Context Menu integrates local state/glyph feedback at its own parts, using the reached installed executor.
